params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Aurora's''' damaging {{tip|basic attacks}} and {{tip|abilities}} apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Spirit Abjuration'' to enemies for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times. The third stack against a target consumes them all to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|1% {{as|(+ {{fd|2.7}}% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''maximum''' health}}, capped at {{pplevel|90+10*x}} against {{tip|monsters}}.
params.description2: Upon consuming the stacks from a {{tip|champion}}, '''Aurora''' additionally exorcises them, freeing a {{as|Spirit|buzzword}} from the target that follows her for the same duration. For each active {{as|Spirit|buzzword}}, '''Aurora''' is {{tip|heal|healed}} for {{pplevel|2 + x|color=heal}} {{as|(+ 2% AP)}} every second. Subsequent exorcisms free further {{as|Spirits|buzzword}} and refresh all active {{as|Spirits|buzzword}}. '''Aurora''' may have up to 4 {{as|Spirits|buzzword}} at a time, for a maximum heal per tick of {{pplevel|(2 + x)*4|color=heal}} {{as|(+ {{ap|2*4}}% AP)}}.
params.notes:
* {{ii|Runaan's Hurricane}} bolts are also empowered to apply stacks (while other effects that apply {{tip|on-hit|on-hits}}, like {{ii|Guinsoo's Rageblade}}, are not).
* The spirits grant vision of a small area around themselves.

description.plain: Innate: Aurora's damaging basic attacks and abilities apply a stack of Spirit Abjuration to enemies for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times. The third stack against a target consumes them all to deal bonus magic damage equal to 1% (+ 2.7% per 100 AP) of the target's maximum health, capped at 100 – 270 (based on level) against monsters.

description2.plain: Upon consuming the stacks from a champion, Aurora additionally exorcises them, freeing a Spirit from the target that follows her for the same duration. For each active Spirit, Aurora is healed for 3 – 20 (based on level) (+ 2% AP) every second. Subsequent exorcisms free further Spirits and refresh all active Spirits. Aurora may have up to 4 Spirits at a time, for a maximum heal per tick of 12 – 80 (based on level) (+ 8% AP).

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aurora''' fires a bolt of energy in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and marks them with a curse for {{fd|3.5}} seconds.
params.description2: ''Twofold Hex'' can be recast after {{fd|0.1}} seconds while at least one target is marked, and does so automatically at the end of the mark's duration.
params.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Aurora''' expunges the curse from all marked targets, drawing the spiritual energy back to her as bolts that each deal {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies they pass through, reduced to 40% against {{tip|minions}} and 50% against {{tip|monsters}} and increased by {{pp|key=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|0 to 100*(1.5-1) for 11|0 to 100|key1=%|formula=0.5% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health|color=health}}. Subsequent bolts against an enemy deal {{ap|0.2*100}}% damage.
params.leveling3:
{{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|45 to 145}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|45*1.5 to 145*1.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*1.5}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Subsequent Bolt Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|45*0.2 to 145*0.2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*0.2}}% AP)}}|Subsequent Bolt Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|45*1.5*0.2 to 145*1.5*0.2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*1.5*0.2}}% AP)}}}}
params.notes:
* ''Twofold Hex'' can also be recast for {{fd|0.66}} seconds after the {{fd|0.1}}-second delay. If the recast is used during this time window, ''Twofold Hex'' will be buffered to recast automatically as soon as the bolt missile from the first cast has fizzled from reaching maximum range, even if no targets are marked. This automatic recast can also be buffered during ''Twofold Hex's'' cast time.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} can block the effects of the active and the recast.
* The marked targets do not need to be visible in order for '''Aurora''' to recast ''Twofold Hex''.
** They do however need to be targetable; if all marked targets are {{tip|untargetable}}, ''Twofold Hex's'' recast is disabled.
* Once '''Aurora''' has successfully recast ''Twofold Hex'', she will not be able to recast it again for the duration regardless of any number of marked enemies still remaining.
** If all enemies marked by ''Twofold Hex'' are {{tip|untargetable}} when '''Aurora''' manually recasts ''Twofold Hex'', the ability will be consumed but evidently without effect. It will however automatically recast again at the end of the marks' duration to expunge any remaining marks.{{bug|2}}
{{Effect at cast time end}}

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aurora''' {{tip|dash|hops}} in the target direction inside a portal to the Spirit Realm. Upon {{tt|completing|See notes}} the dash, she becomes {{tip|invisible}} for a duration and gains ''Realm Hopper'' for 4 seconds.
params.description2: {{sbc|Realm Hopper:}} '''Aurora''' becomes {{tip|ghosted}} and gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for the duration.
params.description3: Scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy {{tip|champion}} within 3 seconds of damaging them will reset ''Across the Veil's'' {{sti|cooldown}}.
params.range: {{dv|{{tt|300|Regular dash distance}}|{{tt|450|Increased dash distance across terrain}}}}
params.notes:
* '''Aurora''' will '''not''' gain the stealth if her dash is interrupted.
** She will however gain the stealth despite the dash being interrupted from colliding with ''{{ais|Between Worlds|Aurora}}'' border.
*** Her dash is interrupted in this case from being overridden by the rift dash.
* '''Aurora''' is locked out of using all abilities, summoner spells, and item actives during the dash.
** She cannot buffer these spells to cast after the lockout. This is in place to prevent her from breaking the stealth from certain spell casts.
*** This is the case even for spells that do not break stealth when cast.
* Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the end of the attack windup.
* At rank 0, ''Realm Hopper'' will grant '''Aurora''' {{as|15% '''bonus''' movement speed}}. This is only relevant for using ''{{ai|Between Worlds|Aurora}}''.
* If the '''total''' duration of ''Realm Hopper'' gained from a new cast of ''Across the Veil'' or ''{{ai|Between Worlds|Aurora}}'' is longer than the '''remaining''' duration of the one gained from a previous cast, then re-gaining ''Realm Hopper'' will override the previous buff's duration.
** If the '''remaining''' duration from a previous cast is shorter, then the same buff remains in place without refreshing.
*** In both cases, the buff cannot stack with itself.
<!-- Blurb -->

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aurora''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} in the target direction with {{tip|displacement immunity}} over {{fd|0.4}} seconds. She then gains ''{{ai|Across the Veil|Aurora|Realm Hopper}}'' for a duration and unleashes a shockwave from {{tt|425 units|Estimated}} in front of her, expanding over {{fd|0.75}} seconds to deal {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow}} them by 30% for 2 seconds.
params.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|175 to 375}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}}}
{{st|''{{ai|Across the Veil|Aurora|Realm Hopper}}'' Duration|{{ap|4 to 5}} seconds}}
params.description2: The shockwave leaves behind a circular rift to the Spirit Realm for a duration, forming borders that interact with '''Aurora''' and enemies. If '''Aurora''' {{tt|collides|See notes}} with the border, she {{tip|dash|dashes}} to the diametrically opposite side of the rift over {{fd|0.4}} seconds, becoming {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} during the travel. If an enemy {{tt|collides|See notes}} with the border, they are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 50% for a duration.
params.leveling2:
{{st|Rift Duration|{{ap|2.25 to 3.25}} seconds}}
{{st|Slow Duration|{{ap|1.5 to 2}} seconds}}
params.description3: ''Between Worlds'' can be recast after 1 second of unleashing the shockwave while the rift is active.
params.description5: ''The rift closes immediately if '''Aurora''' {{tip|death|dies}}, enters {{tip|resurrection}}, leaves the area, or is not within the area upon creation.''
params.range: {{dv|{{tt|25 – 250|Minimum and maximum initial dash distance}}|{{tt|450|Maximum extended initial dash distance through terrain}}}}
params.notes:
* Collision with the border is essentially moving within range of it while being targetable, including via normal movement, dash, or displacement.
** '''Aurora''' and enemies can collide with the border any number of times, as much as the duration permits.
*** Enemies can be applied the slow by colliding with the border only once after moving within collision radius of it. The slow may be applied again from collision only until after they have left the collision radius; it cannot be continuously applied while enemies remain within collision radius of the border.
** {{tip|Untargetable}} units cannot collide with the border, including '''Aurora''' herself.
* The in-game tooltip incorrectly lists the rift duration as {{fd|0.75}} seconds longer than it actually is.{{bug}}
** It is seemingly including the time required for the shockwave to fully expand. However, the rift and its borders will only form after the fact, so the actual duration of the rift is shorter.
* ''Between Worlds' '' {{tip|untargetability}} from the rift dash does not {{tip|homing projectile destruction|destroy}} in-flight {{tip|projectiles}}.
* ''Between Worlds' '' first cast is disabled while {{tip|ground|grounded}} or {{tip|root|rooted}}.
* '''Aurora''' can still dash from colliding with the border even if she is {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|ground|grounded}}.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} can block both the shockwave and border collision.
* The initial cast's dash completes prematurely if ''Between Worlds'' is cast inside terrain while '''Aurora''' is right next to the wall.
** This causes the shockwave to be released instantly after cast.
* If the location on the opposite side of the rift is within the boundaries of terrain, due to the border being inside terrain, '''Aurora''' will only dash to the closest valid spot next to the terrain to avoid exiting the rift's radius.
** However, if that location is close to the edge of the terrain on the other side, '''Aurora''' will dash through the rift's border and over the wall, which causes her to exit the rift (thus closing the rift).{{bug|2}}
* A pair of portals signifying '''Aurora's''' nearest possible entry and its corresponding exit is visible to her at all times.
* Despite supposedly not being a projectile, the damage from ''Between Worlds'' gets reflected by {{cai|Rebuttal|Mel}}, dealing damage and applying a mark of {{cai|Spirit Abjuration|Aurora}} to all of Aurora's allies in range, but only if it has not hit another enemy champion first.
** If the damage hits any enemy champion before interacting with Rebuttal, ''Between Worlds'' will only hit enemies, including {{ci|Mel}}.
*** '''Aurora''' can still pass through the edge of the spell to open a portal and dash to the other side, even if it has been reflected by ''Rebuttal''.
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Aurora''' is dashing:
** This lockout applies to both the initial dash and the dashes in the formed rift.
*** '''Aurora's''' abilities remain locked out for another {{fd|0.5}} seconds after the initial dash ends.
*** The lockout during the rift dash persists for another {{fd|0.15}} seconds after the dash ends.
